title: lepidium virginicum var. menziesii
intro: Lepidium virginicum var. menziesii, commonly known as Western Peppergrass, is a variety of wild mustard plant native to North America. Western Peppergrass has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which can help to relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis, coughs, and colds. The bioactive constituents of Western Peppergrass include isothiocyanates, which are known for their potential therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-cancer, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Western Peppergrass include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and supporting respiratory health.
